  have h_main : ∀ (n : ℕ), List.iterate f a n = match n with
    | 0 => []
    | n + 1 => a :: List.iterate f (f a) n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simp [List.iterate]
    | succ n ih =>

      | zero =>
        simp [List.iterate, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      | succ n =>
        simp_all [List.iterate, Function.iterate_succ_apply', Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
        <;> aesop
